title: Deduplicating: in SQL vs in Python

objectives.text: Remove duplicates in Python with a set or a dict keyed on a chosen natural key, keeping either the first or the latest record
Remove duplicates in SQL with DISTINCT ON or ROW_NUMBER() over a partition
Choose where to deduplicate, in Python before loading or in SQL after loading, for a described data size and pipeline step, and justify the choice
